players.product: Hyperscale AI data-center campus with behind-the-meter power (Project Matador, Texas): powered land, powered shell and turnkey data centers leased to AI compute tenants (first tenant TensorWave, 222 MW initial phase)

quarterly_data.signal: Supplier Energy Transfer (as stated in the October 2025 IPO prospectus): in September 2025 Fermi entered into a gas supply agreement and a gas purchase agreement with ETC Marketing, Ltd., an affiliate of Energy Transfer, granting ETC the exclusive right, for a term of 15 years, to provide a firm supply of natural gas for Project Matador for the first 300,000 MMBtus per day. Subject to certain conditions, ETC will supply up to 210,000 MMBtu per day and no less than 10,000 MMBtu per day for the first year following the delivery commencement date, up to 300,000 MMBtu per day and no less than 210,000 MMBtu per day for the second year, and 300,000 MMBtu per day for the remainder of the delivery period; ETC may match the best third-party bid for supply above that amount, and if Fermi reasonably believes Project Matador will require at least 300,000 MMBtu per day within the 24-month period from September 5, 2025, ETC will commence development of a new natural gas pipeline to the site.
quarterly_data.figure: 15-year exclusive firm gas supply for the first 300,000 MMBtus per day (agreement signed September 2025)

quarterly_data.signal: Origin of Fermi's turbine fleet (as stated in the October 2025 IPO prospectus): through the Firebird Acquisition, closed July 29, 2025, Fermi holds the turnkey Siemens Contract for a new, warranted Siemens 6x1 SGT-800 combined cycle system - six Siemens SGT-800 frame class gas turbines (57MW per turbine), six heat recovery steam generators and one Siemens SST-600 steam turbine - rated 487 MW at ISO conditions and roughly 400 MW at site elevation; payments under the Siemens Contract are denominated in Swedish Kroner. Fermi also closed the acquisition of three used GE 6B gas turbines and one used GE steam turbine from a United States project that operated them in combined cycle cogeneration mode, to be overhauled by qualified GE maintenance and overhaul service providers; with new heat recovery steam generators they were projected to provide roughly 180 MW of base load capacity.
quarterly_data.figure: Siemens 6x1 SGT-800 system 487 MW at ISO / roughly 400 MW at site (57MW per turbine); GE 6B combined cycle roughly 180 MW (prospectus projection)

quarterly_data.signal: Nuclear licensing (as stated in the October 2025 IPO prospectus): Fermi filed its Combined License Application with the NRC on June 17, 2025 for 4 GW of nuclear power - the deployment of up to four Westinghouse AP1000 pressurized water reactors - and the NRC accepted it for review on September 5, 2025. As of the prospectus date Fermi was in active discussions with Westinghouse regarding the procurement of the reactors but did not have a binding agreement with Westinghouse. Plan as of the prospectus date: 1 MW of 4-hour duration BESS for every 3 MW of IT compute load on the Project Matador site.
quarterly_data.figure: 4 GW nuclear COL application (up to four AP1000 reactors), filed June 17, 2025, accepted for review September 5, 2025

quarterly_data.signal: Nuclear partners (as stated in the October 2025 IPO prospectus): on August 25, 2025 Fermi signed a non-binding memorandum of understanding with Doosan Enerbility to explore large commercial nuclear power plants and SMRs, including Doosan supporting the supply of nuclear components and equipment for Project Matador and Fermi's intention to procure certain nuclear components and equipment directly from Doosan in bulk as owner-furnished equipment for its EPC partners; the same day it signed a non-binding MOU with Korean Hydro & Nuclear Power (KHNP) and Samsung C&T as a general framework for cooperation in the development and execution of Project Matador.
